label: Volcanic
description: Volcanic landforms as hero subjects — the planet under construction, temperature readable as color.

items.name: lava-fountain
items.text: a gas-driven lava fountain roaring from the vent, clots of spatter cooling from yellow through orange as they fly, incandescent rivers draining downslope

items.name: crater-lake
items.text: a caldera lake of impossible blue ringed by ash slopes — fed by nothing but rain and snowmelt, so clear it holds only the color of scattered light

items.name: basalt-columns
items.text: hexagonal basalt columns stacked like organ pipes down to the sea, shrinkage joints from a lava flow that cooled slowly enough to crack into geometry

items.name: lava-meets-sea
items.text: molten lava pouring into the sea through bursts of steam, new black land shattering into glassy sand as it quenches, the white plume leaning downwind

items.name: geothermal-field
items.text: a hissing geothermal field of grey mudpots and fumaroles, vents ringed in yellow sulfur crystals and rust-stained clay, steam leaning with the wind

items.name: ash-lightning
items.text: an eruption column laced with volcanic lightning, static charge born of ash grinding against ash, the plume's anvil top shearing off downwind

items.name: pahoehoe-skin
items.text: silver pahoehoe lava skin wrinkling into rope coils, the red interior glowing only through the cracks

items.name: lava-lake
items.text: a convecting lava lake, black crust plates rifting apart along incandescent seams — plate tectonics in miniature

items.name: geyser-eruption
items.text: a geyser erupting in a column of scalding water and steam, sinter terraces stained rust and white around the vent
items.text_short: geyser column over stained sinter terraces
